symbol.pick: What is the chemical symbol for {label}?
symbol.match: Match each element to its symbol.

rows.label: gold
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Au and atomic number 79; a dense, malleable, and corrosion-resistant precious metal widely used as currency, in jewelry, electronics, and as a financial reserve asset
rows.hook: has been used as currency and a symbol of wealth for thousands of years

rows.label: mercury
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Hg and atomic number 80
rows.hook: is the only metal that is liquid at room temperature and was once used in thermometers

rows.label: aluminium
rows.description: metallic chemical element of silvery appearance with symbol Al and atomic number 13
rows.hook: is the lightweight metal used to make soda cans and aircraft frames

rows.label: silver
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ag and atomic number 47
rows.hook: is the best natural conductor of electricity and was traditionally used for coins and jewelry

rows.label: hydrogen
rows.description: chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1
rows.hook: is the lightest and most abundant element in the universe, found in every star

rows.label: tungsten
rows.description: chemical element with symbol W and atomic number 74
rows.hook: has the highest melting point of any metal and was long used in light bulb filaments

rows.label: copper
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cu and atomic number 29
rows.hook: gives old statues like the Statue of Liberty their green patina over time

rows.label: plutonium
rows.description: radioactive chemical element with symbol Pu and atomic number 94
rows.hook: is the radioactive fuel used in some nuclear weapons and deep-space spacecraft power sources

rows.label: oxygen
rows.description: chemical element with symbol O and atomic number 8
rows.hook: makes up about a fifth of the air we breathe and is essential for combustion

rows.label: sulfur
rows.description: chemical element with symbol S and atomic number 16
rows.hook: gives rotten eggs their distinctive smell and was once known as brimstone

rows.label: iron
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Fe and atomic number 26
rows.hook: is the main ingredient of steel and gives blood its red color

rows.label: carbon
rows.description: chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6; common element of all known life
rows.hook: forms the backbone of every living thing and can crystallize into diamond

rows.label: uranium
rows.description: radioactive, metallic chemical element with symbol U and atomic number 92
rows.hook: powers nuclear reactors and was used in the first atomic bombs

rows.label: lead
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Pb and atomic number 82
rows.hook: was once added to paint and gasoline before being banned for its toxicity

rows.label: oganesson
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Og and atomic number 118
rows.hook: is one of the only elements ever named in honor of a scientist who was still living at the time

rows.label: potassium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol K and atomic number 19
rows.hook: is essential for muscle function and is abundant in bananas

rows.label: platinum
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Pt and atomic number 78
rows.hook: is prized in fine jewelry for its rarity and resistance to tarnishing

rows.label: nitrogen
rows.description: chemical element, symbol N and atomic number 7; most abundant element in Earth atmosphere
rows.hook: makes up about four-fifths of the air we breathe and is used to make fertilizer

rows.label: silicon
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Si and atomic number 14
rows.hook: is the main ingredient in computer chips and ordinary sand

rows.label: bismuth
rows.description: Diamagnetic chemical element with symbol Bi and atomic number 83
rows.hook: forms colorful, rainbow-hued crystals and is used in stomach-soothing medicine

rows.label: lithium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Li and atomic number 3
rows.hook: powers rechargeable batteries in phones and electric cars and is used to treat bipolar disorder

rows.label: antimony
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Sb and atomic number of 51
rows.hook: was used by ancient Egyptians as the dark eyeliner in kohl cosmetics

rows.label: tin
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Sn and atomic number 50
rows.hook: was alloyed with copper to make bronze, launching an entire age of history

rows.label: helium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol He and atomic number 2; rare gas; noble gas
rows.hook: makes balloons float and turns voices squeaky when inhaled

rows.label: sodium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Na and atomic number 11
rows.hook: combines with chlorine to form table salt and reacts violently with water

rows.label: krypton
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Kr and atomic number 36; rare gas
rows.hook: is a rare, colorless gas used to fill some specialty light bulbs and photographic flashes

rows.label: phosphorus
rows.description: chemical element with symbol P and atomic number 15
rows.hook: glows faintly in the dark and is a key ingredient in matches and fertilizer

rows.label: cobalt
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Co and atomic number 27
rows.hook: gives certain glass and glazes a deep blue color

rows.label: titanium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ti and atomic number 22
rows.hook: is prized for being both lightweight and extremely strong, used in jet engines and hip implants

rows.label: xenon
rows.description: chemical element with atomic number of 54 and heaviest stable noble gas
rows.hook: is used to fill some high-intensity headlights and specialty flash lamps

rows.label: arsenic
rows.description: chemical element with symbol As and atomic number 33
rows.hook: is a notorious poison, long feared because it was so hard to detect

rows.label: chlorine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cl and atomic number 17
rows.hook: is added to swimming pools and tap water to kill germs

rows.label: boron
rows.description: chemical element with symbol B and atomic number 5
rows.hook: is added to glass to make it resistant to sudden temperature changes

rows.label: magnesium
rows.description: chemical element, symbol Mg and atomic number 12
rows.hook: burns with a blinding white light and is used in fireworks and flares

rows.label: actinium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ac and atomic number 89
rows.hook: glows with a faint blue light in the dark, powered by its own intense radioactivity

rows.label: iodine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol I and atomic number 53
rows.hook: is added to table salt to help prevent a thyroid gland deficiency

rows.label: astatine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol At and atomic number 85
rows.hook: is the rarest naturally occurring element on Earth, with barely any of it existing at any moment

rows.label: zinc
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Zn and atomic number 30
rows.hook: is used to galvanize steel against rust and is found in cold lozenges

rows.label: selenium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Se and atomic number 34
rows.hook: was once used in the light-sensing cells of old photocopiers and light meters

rows.label: osmium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Os and atomic number 76
rows.hook: is the densest naturally occurring element known

rows.label: manganese
rows.description: chemical element, symbol Mn and atomic number 25
rows.hook: is added to steel to make it much harder and more durable

rows.label: chromium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cr and atomic number 24
rows.hook: gives stainless steel its shine and resistance to rust

rows.label: nickel
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ni and atomic number 28
rows.hook: coats many small circulating coins and is used to make stainless steel

rows.label: palladium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Pd and atomic number 46
rows.hook: is used as a catalyst inside catalytic converters to clean car exhaust

rows.label: radon
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Rn and atomic number 86; rare gas
rows.hook: is an invisible radioactive gas that can seep into basements from the ground

rows.label: beryllium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Be and atomic number 4
rows.hook: is a lightweight metal used in aerospace parts and forms the gemstones emerald and aquamarine

rows.label: iridium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ir and atomic number 77
rows.hook: is found in a thin worldwide layer linked to the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs

rows.label: radium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ra and atomic number 88
rows.hook: once glowed in the dark and was used in luminous watch dials before its dangers were known

rows.label: polonium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Po and atomic number 84
rows.hook: is a highly radioactive element that gained notoriety as a poison in a real-life espionage case

rows.label: molybdenum
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Mo and atomic number 42
rows.hook: gets added to steel to make it stronger and better able to withstand extreme heat

rows.label: fluorine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol F and atomic number 9
rows.hook: is added to toothpaste and drinking water to help prevent tooth decay

rows.label: neon
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ne and atomic number 10; rare gas that glows reddish-orange in a vacuum discharge tube
rows.hook: glows bright orange-red inside the glass tubes of illuminated signs

rows.label: bromine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Br and atomic number 35
rows.hook: is one of only two elements that is liquid at room temperature, and was once used in sedative medicines

rows.label: technetium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Tc and atomic number 43
rows.hook: is the radioactive isotope hospitals rely on most often for medical imaging scans

rows.label: argon
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ar and atomic number 18; rare gas
rows.hook: is the inert gas often used to fill incandescent and fluorescent light bulbs

rows.label: calcium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ca and atomic number 20
rows.hook: builds strong bones and teeth and is abundant in dairy products

rows.label: gallium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ga and atomic number 31
rows.hook: is a metal that melts in the palm of your hand from body heat alone

rows.label: vanadium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol V and atomic number 23
rows.hook: strengthens tool steel alloys used in engines and heavy machinery

rows.label: caesium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cs and atomic number 55
rows.hook: defines the length of a second inside atomic clocks

rows.label: cadmium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cd and atomic number of 48
rows.hook: gave its name to a bright yellow paint pigment favored by famous painters for over a century

rows.label: thorium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Th and atomic number 90
rows.hook: is being studied as a possible safer, more abundant fuel for future nuclear power plants

rows.label: tantalum
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ta and atomic number 73
rows.hook: is a key ingredient in the tiny capacitors that let smartphones and laptops function

rows.label: germanium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ge and atomic number 32
rows.hook: was the material used to build some of the very first transistors in early computers

rows.label: moscovium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Mc and atomic number 115
rows.hook: inspired the fictional substance behind a video game zombie outbreak

rows.label: thallium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Tl and atomic number 81
rows.hook: was once sold in creams marketed to remove unwanted hair before doctors realized how toxic it was

rows.label: rhodium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Rh and atomic number 45
rows.hook: is often the most expensive precious metal in the world, pricier than gold or platinum

rows.label: francium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Fr and atomic number 87
rows.hook: has such an unstable nucleus that even its longest lived form disappears within about half an hour

rows.label: californium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cf and atomic number 98
rows.hook: is one of the most expensive materials on Earth, once priced at millions of dollars per gram

rows.label: tennessine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ts and atomic number 117
rows.hook: was named to honor a U.S. state, an honor shared by only one other element on the periodic table

rows.label: zirconium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Zr and atomic number 40
rows.hook: in oxide form is cut into gemstones sold as a diamond substitute

rows.label: yttrium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Y and atomic number 39
rows.hook: helped produce the red glow in the picture tubes of older color television sets

rows.label: niobium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Nb and atomic number 41
rows.hook: can be treated to shimmer in bright colors, making it a favorite for hypoallergenic body jewelry

rows.label: tellurium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Te and atomic number 52
rows.hook: can leave a person with garlic-smelling breath for months after only a tiny bit touches their skin

rows.label: neodymium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Nd and atomic number 60
rows.hook: is used to make some of the strongest permanent magnets in the world

rows.label: americium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Am and atomic number 95
rows.hook: is used inside the smoke detectors found in most homes

rows.label: strontium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Sr and atomic number 38
rows.hook: produces bright red colors in fireworks displays

rows.label: barium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ba and atomic number 56
rows.hook: gives fireworks their bright green burst

rows.label: einsteinium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Es and atomic number 99
rows.hook: was first identified in the fallout from a hydrogen bomb test

rows.label: scandium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Sc and atomic number 21
rows.hook: strengthens the aluminum alloys used in bike frames and baseball bats
